dimensions.assessment: Directly affects small business concerns applying for SBIR or STTR awards and federal agencies administering them.
dimensions.evidence: require Federal agencies to provide enhanced debriefing materials to small business concerns for SBIR or STTR award denials

dimensions.assessment: Provides administrative feedback and evaluation processes to help unsuccessful small business applicants understand denial reasons.
dimensions.evidence: provides such concern an evaluation by the Federal agency of the significant deficiencies in the concern's proposal

dimensions.evidence: Section 9(g) of the Small Business Act (15 U.S.C. 638(g)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent statutory debriefing requirements for federal small business research programs.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires federal agencies to provide enhanced debriefing materials to small businesses denied SBIR or STTR awards upon request. It affects federal agencies administering these programs and small businesses applying for them.
